after.current_activity: The county reports that testing was completed and live drone-delivered AED operations began August 1, 2026, within its joint Police and Fire DFR response. The program provides incident-based aerial awareness and AED delivery under county procedures. The Law Enforcement Center reference point is not every launch or deployment site, and this record does not authorize independent public flight operations.

add_sources.title: USI September 15, 2026 MIC implementation MOA, operator role and performance period

after.current_activity: Newport News announced a $3,061,400 GO Virginia award for the dual-site MIC project in May 2026. USI’s September 15, 2026 announcement describes a memorandum of agreement with the Newport News Economic Development Authority, with Universal Solutions International, Inc. as private implementation partner, program integrator and operator and a performance period through April 30, 2029. Capability and facility language remains future-facing; the announcement does not establish fully commissioned BVLOS infrastructure or open public testing.
after.development_notes: Funded dual-site MIC implementation under the announced September 2026 MOA. Existing PHF airport and NNPRCC club operations are distinct from MIC commissioning. Project roles do not establish real-property ownership, visitor access, BVLOS permissions or completion of all proposed capabilities.
